selected_priority: Eliminate the remaining manual bridge between maintained target-company ATS inventories and application-ready recruiter output by composing discovery directly into the changed-only company-intelligence, ranking, freshness, and recruiter-packet runtime.
displaced_capability: Target opening discovery could maintain attributable Greenhouse/Lever inventories and drive Opening Watch, while the intelligence cycle could build company-aware recruiter packets from supplied candidates. A human or external caller still had to translate discovered openings into IntelligenceCycleCandidate configuration and invoke the full cycle separately.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Keep target discovery and the intelligence cycle as separate executables and generate an intermediate manifest. Preserves both systems but leaves the manual handoff and duplicate-fetch risk intact.

Refactor discovery, watch, and intelligence into one new monolithic runtime. Could reduce surface count but would duplicate or destabilize already-proven state, materiality, freshness, and application contracts.

Selected: add a thin vertical orchestration layer that reuses target discovery with run_watch=false, converts attributable discovered openings into existing IntelligenceCycleCandidate objects, injects the already-normalized JobOpening objects through an in-cycle fetch cache, and delegates materiality plus full intelligence execution to the proven Opening Watch and Intelligence Cycle runtimes.

capabilities: configure a target company once with ATS discovery settings, company-intelligence acquisition plan, mapped application role, and optional current intelligence snapshot
discover attributable live target-company openings and preserve the existing longitudinal inventory state
convert discovered JobOpening objects directly into existing IntelligenceCycleCandidate inputs without inventing a competing application model
validate provider/board uniqueness, target-company attribution, source URLs, acquisition-plan presence, and cross-target duplicate opening URLs before ambiguous execution
reuse the discovered in-memory JobOpening object through Opening Watch and Intelligence Cycle so a selected posting is not fetched a second time

advance NEW or recruiter-material openings automatically through company intelligence acquisition, fit assessment, guarded calibration, ranking, freshness-aware packet lineage, and recruiter-packet compilation
keep unchanged openings on the zero-full-cycle path while preserving inventory/watch history
quarantine superseded recruiter-packet lineage and regenerate only the affected application when a discovered posting changes materially
persist TARGET_INTELLIGENCE_CYCLE_RECEIPT.json with chained discovery/watch receipt hashes and selected-candidate counts
expose the complete vertical workflow as the installed job-app-helix-target-cycle CLI
